title: Topic 56 | Parallel and series connection of capacitors

questions.text: Find the total capacitance of three capacitors of 100 nF, 200 nF and 500 nF connected in series (nF).
Three identical capacitors are connected in parallel to a 2 V voltage source. Each capacitor acquired a charge of 1 nC. Find the total capacitance of the circuit (pF).
Capacitors with capacitances of 6 $\mu F$, 2 $\mu F$ and 4 $\mu F$ are connected in series to a 24 V voltage source. Find the potential difference between the plates of the second capacitor (V).

A voltmeter connected in parallel with an 8 $\mu F$ capacitor attached to a DC source reads 6 V. What voltage (V) will the voltmeter read if a second capacitor of 2 $\mu F$ is connected in series with this capacitor?
A circuit made of two capacitors in series, $C_1 = 1 \, \mu F$ and $C_2 = 3 \, \mu F$, is connected to a DC voltage source $U = 220 \, V$. Determine the voltage across each capacitor (V).

Capacitors of 3 $\mu F$ and 6 $\mu F$ are connected to each other and attached to a battery with an emf of 120 V. If the capacitors are connected in series, determine the potential difference across their plates (V).
Find the total capacitance of the system of capacitors shown in the figure.
Find the total capacitance from the circuit diagram.
In the figure, the capacitance of each capacitor equals C. If the potential difference between points M and N is 120 V, find the potential difference between points K and L (V).

Four capacitors with capacitances $C_1 = 3 \, \mu F, C_2 = 5 \, \mu F, C_3 = 6 \, \mu F$ and $C_4 = 5 \, \mu F$ are connected as shown in the diagram. Determine the total capacitance of the battery ($\mu F$).
Determine the capacitance between points A and B of the capacitor battery shown in the figure.

The capacitance of the capacitor battery in the figure is 5.8 $\mu F$. If $C_2 = 1 \, \mu F, C_3 = 4 \, \mu F$, what are the capacitance of the first capacitor ($\mu F$) and the charge on it ($\mu C$)?
In the circuit in the figure, the charge between terminals K and L equals Q. What is the charge of the capacitor of capacitance C connected between terminals MN?
Find the total capacitance of the system of capacitors shown in the figure.
Two identical capacitors connected in series are half-filled with a substance in two different ways. What is the difference between the voltages across the capacitors (V)?
Find the voltage between points a and b in the capacitor battery shown in the figure (V).

A 3 $\mu F$ capacitor with a charge of 5 $\mu C$ and an 8 $\mu F$ capacitor with a charge of 3 $\mu C$ are connected with like poles together. Find the charge on the first capacitor afterwards ($\mu C$).

A 3 $\mu F$ capacitor with a charge of 5 $\mu C$ and an 8 $\mu F$ capacitor with a charge of 3 $\mu C$ are connected with like poles together. Find the charge on the second capacitor afterwards ($\mu C$).
Two capacitors of capacitance $C$ are charged to voltages $2U$ and $U$. What is the resulting voltage if the capacitors are connected with opposite poles together?
Two capacitors of capacitance $10^4 \, nF$ are charged to voltages of 5 V and 10 V. What is the resulting voltage if they are connected with like poles together?
If capacitors of capacitance $C$ and $2C$, charged to the same extent, are connected in parallel, how does the voltage across the first capacitor change?

An air capacitor charged to a potential difference of 800 V is connected in parallel with an uncharged capacitor of the same dimensions containing a dielectric. The potential difference becomes 100 V. Find the dielectric constant of the dielectric.

A parallel-plate air capacitor is charged to 50 V and disconnected from the source. A metal sheet 1 mm thick is inserted between the plates. The distance between the plates is 5 mm. Determine the new potential difference (V).

Two identical capacitors are connected in parallel and charged to 6 V. After disconnecting them from the source, the distance between the plates of one of them is halved. What is the new potential difference (V)?
A voltmeter connected in parallel with a 12 $\mu F$ capacitor reads 3 V. How many volts will the voltmeter read if a second capacitor of 8 $\mu F$ is connected to it in parallel?
